documents.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Instructional and Assignment Purposes
documents.summary: A Board of Trustees policy covering faculty, staff and students that defines AI, sets baseline duties (disclose use, verify output, protect confidential data, respect IP) and bans fabrication. It leaves permitted uses to the Provost's guidance and to departments or instructors.
documents.stance_why: The policy neither bans nor encourages AI itself: it says 'recognizes the potential benefits', applies duties 'in the instances where use of GAI is permitted', and lets 'the department or instructor of record' set written policies, so it delegates.
